footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 60.5% to $42.7M in 2025. The operating loss widened to $215M from $110M.
The net loss widened to $204M, or −$1.21 per share, from $97.0M. Operating cash flow was −$187M and free cash flow −$188M, versus −$152M.
sources: Wave Life Sciences, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with a history of losses, and we expect to continue to incur losses for the foreseeable future…
We will require substantial additional funding, which may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all
Our operating history as a clinical-stage biotechnology company may make it difficult for shareholders to evaluate the success of our business to…
The approach we are taking to discover and develop RNA medicines is novel and may never lead to marketable products
We may not be able to conduct clinical trials successfully due to various process-related factors that could negatively impact our business plans
Results of preclinical studies and early clinical trials may not be predictive of results of subsequent clinical trials
strategy: Extend our leadership in RNA medicines
Rapidly advance and sustainably grow our differentiated portfolio of RNA medicines
PRISM: Our proprietary discovery and drug development platform
